# relay

> An open-source harness that turns one person's coding-agent subscriptions (Claude, Codex, Grok) into one system: GitHub issues as the task bus, self-hosted runners on your own machines, shared memory in Postgres, and an event feed of everything agents did. Credentials never leave the machine they were created on. Free, Apache-2.0, made by Kyle Roche.

## Start here

- [What relay is](https://relay.kyro.house/): the five rules, how a task flows, quick install, linking model accounts (also as Markdown with Accept: text/markdown)
- [AGENTS.md](https://relay.kyro.house/docs/agents): instructions for coding agents working in or installing relay
- [README](https://relay.kyro.house/docs/readme): what it does, quick install, how to link model accounts

## Guides

- [Architecture](https://relay.kyro.house/docs/architecture): the design and the rules behind it
- [API and MCP](https://relay.kyro.house/docs/api): the read API under /api/v1, rate limits, scopes, and the MCP server at /mcp
- [Versioning and deprecation](https://relay.kyro.house/docs/versioning): how the API changes and the RFC 9745 headers used when something is retired
- [Agent readiness](https://relay.kyro.house/docs/agent-readiness): what the hosted site serves so agents can find, read, and use it

## About this site

- [About](https://relay.kyro.house/about): what relay is, who makes it, open source under Apache-2.0
- [Contact](https://relay.kyro.house/contact): GitHub issues, the operator's address when published, security reporting
- [Privacy](https://relay.kyro.house/privacy): one session cookie after GitHub sign-in, no analytics or trackers, how to delete your data
- The feed, projects, usage, workers and assets are the operator's and need a signed-in session; agents use /api/v1 and /mcp with a bearer token

## Getting access as an agent

Do not ask the person for a token. Request access yourself and they approve it once:

1. `POST https://relay.kyro.house/oauth/device` with `client_name=<your name>` and `scope=tasks:read tasks:write events:write webhooks:write` → `device_code`, `user_code`, `verification_uri`
2. Tell the person to approve `<user_code>` at https://relay.kyro.house/activate, and poll `POST https://relay.kyro.house/oauth/token` with `grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code`, `device_code`, `client_id` every 5 seconds until it returns `access_token` and `refresh_token`
3. Call /mcp or /api/v1 with `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`; `relay_whoami` confirms who you are; refresh with `grant_type=refresh_token` before 24 hours

Alternatives: an invite code from the operator (`grant_type=urn:relay:invite`), or OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and the browser consent page for MCP clients. Every 401 repeats these steps. Metadata: [authorization server](https://relay.kyro.house/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server), [protected resource](https://relay.kyro.house/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource); guide: [/docs/api#access](https://relay.kyro.house/docs/api#access)
